knowhow.phTitle: e.g. Clicking noise near compressor — contactor fault
knowhow.phSymptoms: clicking noise, inside refrigerator, periodic noise
knowhow.phCause: Electromagnetic contactor contact fault causing vibration
knowhow.phCheckSteps:
1. Open electrical panel, check contactor
2. Visually inspect contact vibration during operation
3. Measure current — compare with rated value
4. Check contact wear
knowhow.phSolution: Replace contactor. Verify same capacity/voltage spec.
knowhow.phNotes: If noise repeats at regular intervals, check electrical system before compressor internals.
